title: File Upload Success with Valid Data File
description: Verify that a valid data file can be successfully uploaded via the multipart POST /api/upload endpoint and that the backend returns a secure file path with correct metadata.

steps.description: Navigate to the File upload page
Select a valid data file (e.g., CSV, Parquet, JSON)
Submit the file using the upload form
Verify that the response status is 200 OK
Verify that a secure file path and correct metadata (filename, size, content-type) are returned
Verify the file is stored securely on the backend and accessible via artifact URLs

title: File Upload Failure with Unsupported File Format
description: Verify that uploading a file with an unsupported format results in an appropriate error response and the file is not stored.

steps.description: Navigate to the File upload page
Select a file with unsupported format (e.g., .exe, .bat)
Submit the file using the upload form
Verify that the response status indicates failure (e.g., 415 Unsupported Media Type)
Verify that an error message is presented to the user indicating unsupported file format
Verify that no file is stored on the backend

title: Inspection of Uploaded File with Head Sampling
description: Verify that backend inspects an uploaded file using head sampling strategy with limit and seed, returning correct sample rows, inferred schema, and statistics.

steps.description: Upload a valid data file
Configure sampling strategy to 'head' with a specific row limit and seed
Call /api/inspect endpoint with sampling parameters
Verify the sample rows returned correspond to the first N rows as per limit
Verify the inferred schema matches the data columns and types accurately
Verify statistics such as null values count and cardinality per column are correct

title: Inspection of Uploaded File with Random Sampling and Seed Determinism
description: Verify that random sampling with a fixed seed produces consistent sample rows on multiple inspections.

steps.description: Upload a valid data file
Configure sampling strategy to 'random' with a specific row limit and fixed seed
Invoke /api/inspect endpoint to get sample data
Capture the sample rows
Re-invoke /api/inspect endpoint with identical parameters
Verify the sample rows are identical to the previous response to confirm determinism

title: Inspection Response Handling for Corrupted File
description: Verify that submitting a corrupted or malformed data file to /api/inspect returns an appropriate error without crashing backend.

steps.description: Upload a corrupted or partially invalid data file
Make an inspect request with any sampling strategy
Verify that the backend returns an error status with descriptive error message
Verify that the frontend displays the error message properly
Verify no partial or invalid schema/sample data is returned

title: Python Script Generation via OpenAI API Integration
description: Verify that code generation endpoint /api/generate returns a valid Python analysis script using the configured OpenAI API and that script matches inspection results and user preferences.

steps.description: After successful inspection, trigger code generation with given preferences (visualization library, output dir)
Call /api/generate endpoint
Verify the returned script is valid Python syntax without errors
Verify the script content includes references to the inspected schema and chosen configurations
Verify the script preview panel in frontend matches the generated script

title: Python Script Generation Fallback to Static Template
description: Verify that when OpenAI API is unavailable, the backend falls back to a static template for script generation and returns a valid script.

steps.description: Simulate OpenAI API failure or disable integration
Trigger code generation
Verify the backend returns a valid Python script based on the static template
Verify the returned script is usable and includes basic analysis structure

title: Script Execution Streaming Logs and Artifact Collection
description: Verify that executing the generated Python script via /api/execute streams real-time logs to frontend and produces expected artifact files like charts and HTML reports.

steps.description: Provide valid execution configuration (visualization library, output directory, CPU/memory hints)
Trigger script execution via /api/execute
Verify logs are streamed progressively to the frontend without long delays
Verify that execution completes without errors
Verify expected artifact files (plot images, HTML reports) are available and accessible via frontend

title: Script Execution Failure Scenario and Error Handling
description: Verify that when script execution encounters errors, logs stream errors in real-time and final failure status is correctly reflected on frontend with error details.

steps.description: Modify generated script to induce a runtime error (e.g., syntax error or invalid operation)
Trigger script execution
Verify logs contain error messages streamed progressively
Verify frontend shows execution failure state with proper error feedback
Verify no incomplete or misleading artifacts are shown

title: UI State Transitions Through Workflow
description: Verify frontend UI components transition through the expected states: idle → inspecting → generating → executing → succeeded/failure with appropriate user feedback and loading indicators.

steps.description: Start on File upload page (idle)
Upload file and initiate inspection
Verify UI shows inspecting loading state and disables relevant controls
Upon inspection success, trigger code generation
Verify UI shows generating loading state and then displays script preview
Configure and start script execution
Verify UI shows executing loading state with live log streaming
Verify UI transitions to succeeded or failure states appropriately at execution end

title: Virtualized Sample Table Displays Large Data Efficiently
description: Verify the Inspect results sample preview panel displays large sample datasets using virtualization, ensuring smooth scroll and low memory usage.

steps.description: Upload a large data file (e.g., 10,000+ rows)
Perform inspection with a large sample size
Verify the sample table renders rows responsively with smooth vertical scrolling
Verify memory and CPU usage remains reasonable during navigation

title: Accessibility Compliance of UI Controls and Navigation
description: Verify all UI components including File chooser, Inspect results, Script preview, and Results gallery comply with ARIA standards and are fully operable via keyboard navigation.

steps.description: Navigate through all main UI components using keyboard only (Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Arrow keys)
Verify all interactive controls receive focus in logical order and are operable
Verify ARIA roles and attributes are present and valid (using accessibility tools)
Verify screen reader announces UI elements and state changes correctly

title: Session State Persistence Across Browser Reloads
description: Verify that session settings, including uploaded file information, sampling configurations, generated script, execution logs, and results persist across browser reloads.

steps.description: Complete a full workflow: upload file, inspect, generate script, execute, and view results
Reload the browser page or restart frontend app
Verify all previously configured settings and data are restored
Verify the user can continue working without loss of state

title: Contract Tests for Frontend-Backend API Payload Compatibility
description: Verify that frontend and backend payload schemas align for all typed API endpoints (/api/upload, /api/inspect, /api/generate, /api/execute) to prevent integration errors.

steps.description: Generate or obtain frontend API client types
Compare backend API response and request payload schemas against frontend type expectations
Verify no schema mismatches exist and data types are consistent

title: End-to-End User Flow Testing
description: Verify the complete user journey from file upload through results gallery including all intermediate states, UI responses, and error handling scenarios.

steps.description: Navigate to application URL
Upload a valid data file
Configure sampling and invoke inspection
Verify sample and schema preview
Generate Python analysis script
Verify script preview matches backend output
Configure execution settings and run script
Verify streaming logs are shown
Verify gallery shows correct visualizations and artifact links
Copy and download generated script
Verify scripts match expected content and downloads succeed
